File: src/export/scheduler.ts

Fix weekly scheduled exports so that when a schedule is created on the same day but before the run hour, `nextRunAt` schedules the first run for that day instead of advancing a full week ahead.
args.title: Include the current week in weekly scheduled exports when created early
